```plato

// How a track behaves when sampled outside its keyed range: clamp to the
// boundary key's value (Hold), repeat the keyed range (Loop), alternate
// forward and reversed repeats (PingPong), extrapolate along the boundary
// slope (LinearContinue), or repeat while offsetting each cycle by the
// range's net value change (LoopWithOffset).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Extrapolation)
type Extrapolation = Hold | Loop | PingPong | LinearContinue | LoopWithOffset;
```
